steps.en: Driver particulars for a foreign vehicle notice are received in OCMS
steps.id: Particulars driver untuk notice kendaraan asing diterima di OCMS
steps.why_en: Only a generic furnish form exists; nothing is specific to foreign-vehicle reminders.
steps.why_id: Hanya form furnish umum yang ada; tidak ada yang khusus reminder kendaraan asing.

steps.en: Unpaid foreign notices are picked for a reminder letter
steps.id: Notice kendaraan asing yang belum bayar dipilih untuk letter reminder
steps.why_en: The system deliberately leaves foreign vehicles out of reminder letters.
steps.why_id: Sistem sengaja mengeluarkan kendaraan asing dari letter reminder.

steps.en: A reminder data file is built for an outside party
steps.id: Data file reminder dibuat untuk pihak luar
steps.why_en: A file for foreign notices exists, but it is a case file, not a reminder letter.
steps.why_id: File untuk notice asing ada, tapi itu file kasus, bukan letter reminder.

steps.en: The file goes to the vendor for printing and postage
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor untuk cetak dan kirim pos
steps.why_en: Vendor upload is generic, skips foreign vehicles, and is off in the prod config.
steps.why_id: Upload ke vendor bersifat umum, melewati kendaraan asing, dan mati di config prod.

steps.en: The driver is informed of the overdue fine
steps.id: Driver diberi tahu soal denda yang overdue
steps.why_en: Only an admin fee is added; nobody tells the driver.
steps.why_id: Hanya admin fee yang ditambahkan; tidak ada yang memberi tahu driver.
